source.tone_mapping: No exposure, filmic curve, ACES transform, LUT, or color matrix occurs in the decoded gamma-correction fragment programs.

implementation.operation: Clamp the recovered linear LGPE surface result to the source UNORM interval, then apply the decoded standard sRGB transfer.

implementation.preserved_boundary: Generic engine PBR materials retain their existing selectable tone-mapping path.

The source runs it once after scene composition; moving the equation to that global stage remains necessary for exact linear alpha blending and mixed-scene parity.

open_boundaries: Promote the recovered equation from the current material-output emulation to one shared linear scene-color post pass on all three backends.
